An '''unidentified [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]]''' worked as a mechanic for the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]]. They were present at the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and worked on Teemto's pod there.<ref name="TPM" />
